description: This file is a C# source code file that defines a helper class for testing buffer serialization and deserialization in the Orleans serialization framework. It contains utility classes, interfaces, and methods for testing different buffer writer implementations with configurable options.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper`1
classes.description: Helper for testing buffer types, providing methods to get test serializers for a specific TValue type.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper`1.IBufferTestSerializer
classes.description: Interface defining serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper`1.BufferTester`1
classes.description: Abstract base class for buffer tester implementations, handling serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper`1.MultiSegmentBufferWriterTester
classes.description: Implementation of BufferTester for MultiSegmentBufferWriter with configurable options.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper`1.PooledOutputBuffer
classes.description: Struct implementing IBufferWriter and IOutputBuffer backed by a pooled buffer, IDisposable.

methods.name: GetTestSerializers
methods.description: Creates an array of IBufferTestSerializer instances for different buffer implementations.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a TValue input into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a buffer into an output TValue.

methods.name: CreateBufferWriter
methods.description: Abstract method to create a buffer writer, implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the buffer writer tester instance.
